title: QANDA – An AI Tutor for everyone, advancing equity in education
summary: Mathpresso reports that its *QANDA* app gives students real-time question solving, adaptive feedback and study plans; no source measures learning gains.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Mathpresso added AI answer search to its QANDA tutoring app in October 2017. On 25 August 2023 Chosun Edu reported the beta launch of Poly, a tutor built on large language models inside the QANDA app, and said that ten million students used the app each month. A Wikipedia article flagged for a close connection with the company reports 90 million registered users and 8 million monthly active users in 50 countries as of March 2024. In a project account current as of June 2025, Mathpresso describes real-time question solving, adaptive feedback and study plans through the deployed QANDA platform. No source measures learning gains or reductions in educational inequality.

display.answer: Observed August 2023. The record describes QANDA as a tutor that combines OCR with large language models. On 25 August 2023 Chosun Edu reported that Mathpresso had launched a beta of Poly, its generative-AI tutor inside the QANDA app. An earlier LLM bot had opened to some users in March 2023, and photo-based answer search dates from October 2017.
Whether others have replicated the result is unclear.
